claims.statement: Retained: for every unordered profile r_i in {2,3,4} with 1<=m<=40 in the specified path-and-branches ordinary-tree family, every rank satisfying x+2<=p and 3p<2alpha+1 has strictly negative complete original favorable-leaf sum S(T,p).
claims.scope: Bounded exact coefficient-recurrence census of 12,340 profiles and 191,016 eligible profile/rank pairs, with six fixed actual-tree graph-DP checks (164 polynomial comparisons). No extension beyond this family and m-boundary.
claims.reason: retained — the recurrence split, terminal zero-extended descent, strict rank guards, strict deletion selectors, and distinct-leaf multiplicities are consistent with the contract. The scratch replay reproduces every reported census total and the six graph-DP checks with no mismatch. This establishes only the stated bounded family result; it does not resolve the arbitrary-tree claim.

limitations: The census covers only 1<=m<=40 in the specified path-and-branches family; it does not cover the full m<2000 prefix or an infinite family.
It does not prove or refute the arbitrary ordinary-tree favorable-leaf aggregate.
Actual graph-DP checks cover six fixed profiles; exhaustive bounded coverage depends on the exact coefficient recurrences.
Central log-concavity checks are finite and limited to the listed polynomials and central rank interval; they establish no mixed-minor or uniform analytic claim.
